salary: The following table illustrates possible monthly remuneration based on working five hours per day. title: Chief Compliance Officer     – 1 Posts
selection_process: The selection process for the Chief Compliance Officer post comprises: || Preliminary Scrutiny:Checking applications with reference to age, qualifications, experience, and other eligibility conditions. || Shortlisting:Shortlisting candidates based on relevant experience, seniority, professional credentials, academic track record, and suitability. || Personal Interaction / Interview:An interview before a duly constituted Selection Committee assessing knowledge of credit, market, operational, liquidity, technology, cyber, climate risks, leadership ability, independence of judgement, and regulatory awareness. || Verification:Verification of credentials, vigilance status, integrity, reputation, and antecedents, followed by medical fitness and background checks. Final selection is based on marks obtained in the interview process according to merit ranking.

salary: Apprentices are not eligible for any other allowances or benefits. Daily training hours are as applicable to the Bank's clerical staff. Transport, hostel or any other residential accommodation is not provided.
age_limit: The age limit is a minimum of 20 years and a maximum of 28 years as on 1 October 2026 (the maximum applies to Unreserved and EWS candidates).
application_fee: The fee is paid online to BFSI SSC through the secure payment link in the application form, between 14 October and 29 October 2026. It is non-refundable under any circumstances, whether or not the candidate attends the test or is shortlisted, and cannot be adjusted against any other selection process.
